lever_cross_check.scope_note: LeVer synthesizes and checks a reference candidate from the requirement text. It does not verify DeFiAgent.sol itself; a pass is not a security guarantee.

manual_review.method: Manual mapping of DeFiAgent.sol against the LeVer property library (lever/property.json). This is a code review by the assistant, not LeVer output, and has not been run through Hardhat or a formal tool. Team confirmation pending. MR-1 and MR-2 were fixed after the review and covered by Hardhat tests (27 passing, run with a solc-js compiler in a sandbox); the fix itself has not been re-reviewed by a second person or by LeVer.

findings.title: Staked funds can be locked while paused
findings.detail: unstake() has the notPaused modifier and the contract has no way to change or renounce the owner. If the owner pauses (or loses the key while paused), stakers cannot withdraw.
findings.recommendation: Remove notPaused from unstake() so withdrawal always works; keep pause for transfer and stake only.
findings.resolution: Removed notPaused from unstake(); pause now blocks only transfer and stake. Hardhat tests: unstake works while paused, stake still blocked while paused.

findings.title: Integrity anchor can be pre-empted by another wallet
findings.detail: anchorIntegrity() is first-come per requestId and does not bind the anchor to the caller. A wallet that sees the pending transaction can anchor a different hash first, and anchors cannot be changed, so the correct hash can never be stored (FR-08).
findings.recommendation: Key the mapping by (msg.sender, requestId) or store the anchoring wallet and require it to match; add a test for this case.
findings.resolution: integrityAnchors is now keyed by (wallet, requestId) and getIntegrityHash takes (wallet, requestId). Hardhat tests: another wallet cannot pre-empt or block an anchor; anchors are not readable across wallets.

findings.title: unstake() emits no event
findings.detail: stake and transfer emit events that form the on-chain record, but unstake does not, so withdrawals are missing from the on-chain trail.

findings.title: Stray Ether cannot be recovered
findings.detail: receive() and fallback() accept Ether with no accounting or withdrawal path. Solvency still holds, but accidental transfers are locked.
findings.recommendation: Remove the payable fallback, or document it as accepted behaviour.

findings.title: Swap and ERC-20 are not on-chain
findings.detail: The contract implements transfer (ETH), stake/unstake and anchoring only. README already states swap and staking are simulated, and ERC-20 needs extra setup.
findings.recommendation: Keep the documented limitation visible in the SRS and viva material.

satisfied.note: Solidity 0.8.20 checked arithmetic; no unchecked blocks.
unstake() reduces stakedBalance before the external call; transfer() holds no state.
Both low-level calls check the success flag.
stakedBalance only grows by msg.value and shrinks before payout.
transfer and stake are capped per transaction by maxTransferAmount (matches MAX_TX_AMOUNT_ETH).
A reverting recipient only reverts its own transfer; no shared state is blocked.
Anchors are per wallet; another wallet cannot pre-empt them.
